text.headline: Timeline of Seychelles
text.text: Major events in the history of Seychelles.

events.headline: Early Cultures and Societies
events.text: Ancient peoples inhabit the lands of Seychelles, developing trade, language, and belief systems.

events.headline: Age of Exploration and External Influence
events.text: Explorers, traders, or neighboring empires shape the political economy of Seychelles.

events.headline: Colonial or Imperial Rule
events.text: Periods of external rule or regional empires leave lasting administrative and cultural legacies in Seychelles.

events.headline: Post–World War II Transitions
events.text: Global shifts reshape governance, economics, and society in Seychelles.

events.headline: Independence or Constitutional Reform
events.text: Seychelles enters a new era through independence, unification, or major constitutional change.

events.headline: Contemporary Developments
events.text: Seychelles focuses on growth, governance, and international partnerships in the 21st century.
